title: Five EU countries announce migrant deportation centre in Rwanda
content: Germany, Denmark, Austria, Greece and the Netherlands have announced a "return hub" for failed asylum seekers.

title: Yemeni forces retreat to defend port city from Houthis
content: Saudi-backed forces say they are moving troops from the Bab al-Mandab Strait to protect the interim capital, Aden.

title: Trump backs return of ex-Nvidia boss after 'Bring Jensen Back' campaign launched
content: A number of tech figures want the board of the AI chip giant to give Jensen Huang his job back.

title: Photos: California residents gather to watch massive El Nino-fuelled waves
content: National Weather Service warns that waves of more than 10 metres high could impact some parts of US's California coast.

title: London Palestine Film Festival returns for 27th year
content: Since 1999, the London Palestine Film Festival has brought Palestinian stories to the big screen.

title: UEFA backs Diallo to challenge Infantino for FIFA presidency
content: UEFA has found its candidate to take on Gianni Infantino in next year’s FIFA presidential election
